facts.claim: Fraserpet is a trading town on the east frontier, situated on the left bank of the Kaveri, on the main road from Seringapatam to Mercara, 20 miles east of the latter.
facts.quote: Fraserpet- — A trading town on the east frontier, situated in N. lat. 12° 27», E. long. 76° 2', on the left bank of the Kaveri, on the main road' from Seringapatam to Mercara, 20 miles east of the latter.

facts.claim: The Kaveri is crossed by a fine stone bridge in Fraserpet.
facts.quote: The Kaveri is here crossed by a fine stone bridge, and the site of the town is very picturesque.

facts.claim: Cross roads from Fraserpet run south to Siddapur, north to Hebale, and north-west to Somvarpet.
facts.quote: Besides the main Mysore-Mercara road which passes through the town, cross roads run south to Siddapur, north to Hebale, and north- west to Somvarpet.
